description: One open position with its full description (tasks, skills, what we offer) and the page to apply on. JOB_NOT_FOUND: the position is not open (any more). Applications are made only on the page of the position (url), with its form, by the candidate; the connector does not apply and receives no personal data. salary null: the website publishes no salary for that position; salary_note is the note of the career page. API v3.

job_id.description: Id of an open position, e.g. receptionist.

lang.description: Language of the position: en, de or el (Greek); default en.

name: get_job
title: Job details
